name: SaunaLife CL4G 3-Person Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna with Full Glass Front & LED Lighting
description: SaunaLife Cube-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Kit, Model CL4G, Up to 3 Persons Convert your backyard into a serene wellness oasis with the SaunaLife CL4G 3-Person Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna. Featuring Scandinavian-inspired design, this sauna combines luxurious craftsmanship with cutting-edge functionality. The full-glass front offers breathtaking outdoor views while flooding the interior with natural light, creating an airy and tranquil atmosphere. With ergonomic seating, advanced LED lighting, and premium Thermo-Spruce materials, this sauna is the perfect blend of style, comfort, and durability for your health and relaxation journey. Experience ultimate relaxation and wellness with SaunaLife CL4G. Elevate your outdoor spa with this seamless addition to your space. Key Features: Spacious 3-Person Capacity: Ideal for enjoying quality relaxation time with family or friends. Premium Thermo-Spruce Construction: Beautiful, durable, and designed to endure outdoor elements. Full Glass Front Design: Expansive tempered glass for natural light and stunning outdoor views. Ergonomic Seating & Backrests: Contoured surfaces provide superior comfort for long sauna sessions. LED Light Bar System with Wi-Fi App Control: Seamless, dotless lighting with wireless operation for customizable ambiance. Shingled Roof Design: Adds extra protection and long-lasting durability.
